magenta.source: src/index.css @theme --color-magenta (also literal in src/App.tsx RouteLine and public/favicon.svg)

display.purpose: Spread title (place, game, search term, 'Near you'): 2.5rem from md up, 1.6rem clamped to two lines on phone. Uppercase, balanced wrap. Built as font-stretch: 68% (Archivo wdth axis).

masthead.purpose: GAME TRAVELLER nameplate, uppercase, 'Traveller' in yellow; 1.9rem from md up, 1.6rem on phone. The 'Filter' heading uses the 1.6rem step.

headline.purpose: Game names in the spread, sentence case as in data; a hover-magenta button in the list variant.

numeral.purpose: Release-year column in each game row.

body.purpose: Running UI text, desktop issue line, meta line under the title, field text, notices. Weight 700 for journey place names and same-era game names.

body-data.purpose: Developer/publisher values, chip, era-chip and route-button text, 'Back to' button, one-line location notes.

subhead.purpose: Sticky place sub-headings in multi-place spreads; 'Nearby', 'Set in the same era', 'The journey' headings. Uppercase, tracking-wide.

label.purpose: Field labels, slider legends, filter badge, section meta, journey step numbers, 'Set in' lines, panel footer; mobile issue line at 0.8125rem.

cluster-numeral.purpose: Game count inside a cluster bullet: 17px, 15px from 100 games up, weight 750, 80% width, tabular. Set inline from src/App.tsx.

map-label.purpose: Permanent caption on route stops, the active place and the reader's position (.leaflet-tooltip.gt-label): 14px bold, 85% width, white on ink.

attribution.purpose: Leaflet attribution line only (.leaflet-control-attribution): 12px. The one step below the 13px floor; third-party chrome, never a model for app text.

shadows.name: dot-halo
shadows.purpose: Single place dot on the map only; removed when dimmed.

shadows.name: bullet-halo
shadows.purpose: Cluster bullet on the map only, including the single-game magenta dot.

shadows.name: user-ring
shadows.purpose: Hard ink outline around the cyan position dot's white ring. Zero blur; an outline, not a shadow.

inkRules.name: rule-heavy
inkRules.purpose: Structural seams: panel to map, filter sides and bottom, spread header, status and empty notices.

inkRules.name: rule-control
inkRules.purpose: Control frames: select, route toggle, outline genre tag, zoom control, active era chip, cover image frame.

inkRules.name: rule-chip-idle
inkRules.purpose: Idle era chip; turns ink on hover.

inkRules.name: rule-subhead
inkRules.purpose: Under a sticky place sub-heading, and the hairline beneath the spread header's heavy rule.

inkRules.name: rule-hairline
inkRules.purpose: Row dividers, filter footer, Nearby and same-era section edges.

focus.name: focus-on-ink
focus.purpose: Search field on the black masthead.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The only custom easing (@theme --ease-out-expo); panels, route draw, marker hover.

motion.name: panel-slide-in
motion.purpose: Location spread and filter sheet entrance.

motion.name: route-draw
motion.value: 1100ms ease-out-expo, 150ms delay; stroke-dashoffset 1 to 0 with pathLength=1

motion.name: map-fly
motion.value: flyTo 0.8s (point, zoom never below 5, shifted 210px right on desktop / 31% up on phone); flyToBounds 1s (route or search, maxZoom 6); cluster flyToBounds 0.8s
motion.purpose: Camera moves, offset for the docked panel. Instant setView/fitBounds when restoring from a shared link.

motion.name: notice-dismiss
motion.purpose: Status notice clears itself unless the text ends in an ellipsis (in progress).

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Below: bottom-sheet spread (max 62% height, 90% when expanded via the handle), search on its own masthead row, full-width filter, 1.6rem nameplate and title, 0.8125rem issue line. At and above: 420px left-docked spread, 400px framed filter inset 24px from the right, 36px min chip/toggle height, 1.9rem nameplate, 2.5rem title.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: The 'Near me' masthead button shows its text label; below it is icon-only.

map.tiles: OpenFreeMap 'positron' vector style rendered by MapLibre GL via @maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet; symbol layers rewritten to coalesce(name_en, name:latin, name). OpenStreetMap raster tiles only if the style fails to load.
map.tileFilter: grayscale(1) contrast(0.92) brightness(1.04) on .leaflet-tile-pane and .leaflet-gl-layer canvas
map.initialView: center [30, 10], zoom 3 on desktop / 2 on phone, minZoom 2, maxZoom 18, worldCopyJump
map.markerHitArea: 44px (place dots, pinned dots, clusters); user marker 24px, not interactive
map.pinned: Route stops, the active place and up to 8 search hits render outside the cluster group as active dots (zIndexOffset 1000); route stops and the active place carry a permanent gt-label caption (offset 0,-14).

clusterSizes.single: 20px magenta dot, 2.5px white ring (one game across several close places)

map.clusterClick: flyToBounds 0.8s while the places can still be separated (fit zoom < 10); otherwise opens the spread in cluster mode
map.zoomControl: 44px buttons, 22px glyphs, 2px ink frame, no radius, no shadow, hover yellow, bottom right

favicon.route: M12 46 L26 30 L40 38 L54 18, stroke #d4006f 4px, round caps and joins
favicon.stops: r=5 #d4006f with 2.5px #fff ring at (12,46) and (40,38); terminal r=7 #121214 with 4px #ffe100 ring at (54,18)
favicon.rasters: favicon-32.png, apple-touch-icon.png, icon-192.png, icon-512.png; manifest background/theme #121214; <meta theme-color> #121214

og.composition: Ink field; 'GAME' white and 'TRAVELLER' yellow in condensed heavy caps; strap 'Where video games take place' in white over a white rule; grey figure line with numbers in yellow; magenta route with white-ringed dots and a yellow-ringed terminal at upper right.

open: Leaflet zoom control uses text glyphs (+ / −) at 22px rather than SVG icons; 22px is off the ramp and recorded here, not canonized.
src/DoubleRangeSlider.tsx still sets Norwegian aria-labels ('… fra' / '… til') while the UI is English.
.impeccable/surfaces/src-app-tsx.md still says 'Norwegian UI copy' and a 400px panel; the build is English and docks the spread at 420px.
Route colour, map ground and dimmed dot are literals in src/App.tsx and src/App.css rather than @theme tokens.

narrative.overview:
The map is the centre spread of a 1990s games magazine, pulled out and laid flat. The world is printed in a single grey ink, and everything the reader can act on is overprinted in CMYK process colour: magenta dots for places, black numbered bullets for clusters, a magenta route line for the selected game's journey, and small black caption labels naming the stops along it. Chrome sits at the edges like a magazine's furniture: a black masthead strip across the top, and a feature spread that docks to the left (desktop) or rises as a bottom sheet (phone).

The type is Archivo in two widths. Headlines are condensed and heavy, the way magazine features set their titles. UI text stays at normal width. Release years carry as much weight as game names, set as large tabular numerals in their own column. Depth comes from ink rules, never from soft shadows or floating cards: heavy 3px rules mark seams, 2px rules frame controls, 1px hairlines divide rows. Every corner is square. The only round forms are the dots printed on the map and the few marks that echo them. The one kind of picture in the product is a game's cover from IGDB, printed small and framed in ink like a thumbnail in a review column.

The density is generous on purpose. The audience is 30 to 60, so app text never drops below 13px (only Leaflet's attribution line is smaller, at 12px), interactive targets are 44px tall on touch, and contrast is ink on white. UI copy is English.
keyCharacteristics: Grey single-ink map; colour only where there is something to act on.
Magenta is the one action and route colour; cyan, yellow and black sort genres.
Condensed heavy Archivo caps for titles, normal-width Archivo for UI.
Ink rules for seams and edges, square corners on everything except map dots.
The year comes first: tabular numerals in their own column.
Place names on the map are set as captions: ink boxes, white condensed bold, no arrow.

rules.name: The One Action Ink Rule
rules.body: Magenta means "act here" or "this is the route". Never use it for genre, decoration or a passive label.

rules.name: The Process Ink Rule
rules.body: Genre tags take one of four fixed treatments: cyan, yellow, black, or a 2px black outline, assigned by a stable hash of the genre name so a genre always looks the same. Magenta is never in that set.

rules.name: The Single Grey Map Rule
rules.body: Map tiles are always desaturated, whatever renders them. The map must not compete with the overprinted dots, labels and route.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Condensed widths are for titles, names and years. Controls, data and running text stay at normal width.

rules.name: The Tabular Years Rule
rules.body: Every year, count and range readout uses tabular lining numerals. Years before 0 are written as "N BC", and spans as "49 BC–2017".

rules.name: The Ramp Rule
rules.body: Sizes come from this ramp and nowhere else: 2.5 / 1.9 / 1.6 / 1 / 0.95 / 0.875 / 0.8125 rem in the chrome, plus 17 and 15px cluster numerals, 14px map captions and the 12px attribution line on the map.

rules.name: The Ink Rule Rule
rules.body: Seams are rules, not shadows. Use 3px ink for structural edges (masthead to panel, panel to map, filter frame, notices), 2px ink for control frames and the cover image, and 1px for dividers (hairline grey between rows, ink under a sticky sub-heading).

dos: **Do** keep map tiles in one grey and overprint everything actionable in process ink.
**Do** reserve magenta for actions, the route and focus.
**Do** separate chrome from the map with 3px ink rules and dock overlays flush to an edge.
**Do** set titles, game names and years in condensed weight-800 Archivo, and years and counts in tabular figures with "BC" for years before 0.
**Do** keep interactive targets at least 44px tall on touch, including map markers and zoom buttons.
**Do** keep every corner square except the dots and bullets printed on the map and the marks that echo them.
**Do** pin route stops and the active place outside clusters and caption them with ink labels.
**Do** frame notices as strips at the top centre of the map: ink for transient status, sheet for empty states.
donts: **Don't** use soft drop shadows, floating rounded cards or blurred panels for chrome. The only shadows are the marker halos.
**Don't** use magenta for genre tags or decoration.
**Don't** fabricate screenshots or artwork. The only imagery is IGDB cover art, 64 by 85px in a 2px ink frame, with its credit in the footer.
**Don't** set controls or running text in the condensed width.
**Don't** add type sizes outside the ramp.
